== Printing-specific Revised face ==
The photographed physical Revised face has the printed title IG-88 and its boxed game text ends with purchase. The following explanation in Glossary 2.0 (November 1998), PDF p. 71, is a separate ruling, not printed game text: although this droid may carry and use two weapons, it counts as only one warrior. Existing identity and family navigation are preserved.
* Physical white-border face: [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/137798219/Ok_ZHzLdsEuc7MBAjfPtmA.jpg complete card photograph]. [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/starwarscollector-1/imagegallery/127305 Collector gallery].
